label: Bank: withdraw compost-run loadout
detail: Withdraw: coins (charter fare + 30 pineapples, total ??), Digsite pendant or Fossil Island transport (??). No other inventory needed — pineapples and ash fill en route.

hints.note: Keep a charged pendant banked separately for repeat runs.

Fossil_Island s1: digsite pendant is the fastest (teleports near the Digsite barge, speak to the barge guard to fast-travel to Museum Camp; can also be charged on the House on the Hill strange machine for a repeatable house-teleport option). Without a pendant: Digsite teleport scroll (lands SW of the barge) or a gnome glider to Lemanto Andra (SW of the barge, reachable via ring of dueling->Emir's Arena glider, Al Kharid gem-trader glider, or a royal seed pod to the Grand Tree glider after Monkey Madness II).

label: Bury bones for Prayer XP
detail: Bury every bone drop during combat training instead of dropping it — zero extra time, steady Prayer XP on the side. Never its own step; badges onto whichever combat step is active.

label: High Alch smithed items
detail: Cast High Level Alchemy on the bars/items produced while training Smithing instead of banking them raw — zero extra time, converts the smithed output to GP while banking Magic XP on the side. Never its own step; badges onto whichever smithing step is active.
